claims.text: Depression is a predictor of Facebook intrusion.
Daily Internet use time in minutes is a predictor of Facebook intrusion.
Being male is a predictor of Facebook intrusion.
Young age is a predictor of Facebook intrusion.

evidence.description: We showed that depression can be a predictor of Facebook intrusion.
Our results provides additional evidence that daily Internet use time in minutes is a predictor of Facebook intrusion.
Facebook intrusion can be predicted by being male.
Facebook intrusion can be predicted by young age.

methodologies.name: Cross-sectional survey with snowball sampling
methodologies.description: A cross-sectional study assessing 672 Facebook users via the Facebook Intrusion Questionnaire and Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale collected through snowball sampling.
conditions: Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale

limitations.text: Previous findings on the relationship between Facebook addiction and depression were not unambiguous.
